note: Wooded two-loop campground in the hills above Cox Hollow Lake. Only two public sites have electric (16 and 55, both accessible); most of the park's electric sites are in Twin Valley. The equestrian campground is separate, in the Hickory Ridge area. --Claude
summary: DNR camping page, park page, Cox Hollow campground map and the DNR notice feed read; GoingToCamp unread (refuses). About 116 numbered sites in two loops, electric at only 16E and 55E (plus the host's 1E), showers/flush/vault toilets, water and dump; reservations required. Pin inside the campground (60 m from the OSM polygon centroid). Not waterfront confirmed. Fees and site lengths unconfirmed.
flags: SITES: the DNR gives only the park total (269 standard sites in Cox Hollow + Twin Valley, 80 electric). The Cox Hollow map numbers sites 1-118 (72 not shown; 8 double sites; 5 and 6 are walk-to tent sites; 1E is the camp host), so about 116 drive-in sites. sites.count not written for want of a stated per-campground figure.

HOOKUPS: only 16E and 55E are public electric sites here (map); the amperage is on no page I could read, so hookups were not written. The old note's 'electric sites' wording made Cox Hollow sound like an electric campground; the new note says only two public sites.

UNCONFIRMED: stored $25-40 (GoingToCamp fee panel 2026-10-10, '32 sites' RV-capable) and per-site equipment lengths are on wisconsin.goingtocamp.com (refuses, not retried). The '32 RV-capable sites' figure from that read suggests most Cox Hollow sites may be typed for tents/short units on GoingToCamp; worth a look in a real browser. The old note's 'Sites fit a 23-ft rig' has no source I could read; dropped.

SEASON: not written. The campground map says 'Reservations, May 1-Labor Day' (old map) while the camping page says reservations are required for all sites; winter camping is at 39 sites (10 plowed as staffing allows, electricity) without saying which campground. Showers/water Memorial Day weekend-Oct. 1.
PIN: 43.0178,-90.1151 is about 60 m from the OSM Cox Hollow Campground polygon centroid (43.01834,-90.11483), inside the campground's south end on imagery. Fine.
WATERFRONT: not waterfront confirmed. Cox Hollow Lake is about 400 m south of the loops through forest; no site is near water.

PHONE: 608-935-2315 confirmed on the park page. WEBSITE: https://dnr.wisconsin.gov/topic/parks/govdodge live (200); the camping page https://dnr.wisconsin.gov/topic/parks/govdodge/recreation/camping is an optional replacement.
